compliance.status: settled; 2016 FSHC settlement agreement; Fourth Round obligation reduced from DCA's 88 to 85 via NJBA settlement
compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center (2016); NJ Builders Association (2025)

notes: DCA assigned Present Need=26 (accepted), Prospective Need=88 (reduced to 85 via NJBA settlement March 21, 2025). VLA approved; Fourth Round RDP=0 (fully developed borough). Unmet need=85. Bogota satisfied its prior+Third Round obligations of 100 units (13 prior round + 87 Third Round) with 5 surplus credits. Fourth Round compliance mechanisms: (1) 5 surplus prior-round credits; (2) The Gabriel (Block 95 Lots 1.01 and 1.02, 5 affordable units + 2.5 bonus = 7.5 credits); (3) Silver Maple Gardens I and II extension of controls (20 credits); (4) mandatory inclusionary zoning requirements via ordinance amendment (Chapter 22B, 2023). As of plan adoption, total confirmed credits = 32.5 of 85 needed. Remaining 52.5 units addressed through ongoing mandatory set-aside ordinance. Candidate snapshot correctly identified the Atwater (former Hess site) as a prior-round credit site but incorrectly called it the sole Fourth Round site; the real Fourth Round sites are The Gabriel and Silver Maple Gardens extension.

sites.quote: The Gabriel – 51 Queen Anne Road (Block 95, Lots 1.01 and 1.02): The Bogota Planning/Zoning Board approved this development in 2022 on a site that was previously occupied by a commercial use, a gasoline service station. The Board granted use, height and bulk variances to permit a four-story multifamily residential building containing 34 dwelling units, including five affordable units.
sites.notes: Generates 5 affordable units + 2.5 bonus credits (former retail/commercial bonus at 0.5 per unit) = 7.5 total credits toward Fourth Round obligation. Since Bogota did not receive a VLA for prior rounds, these credits can be applied to Fourth Round. Built on former gas station site.

sites.site_name: Silver Maple Gardens I and II — Extension of Affordability Controls
sites.lot: 4.01 (Silver Maple Gardens I) and 2.01 (Silver Maple Gardens II)
sites.developer: Housing Development Corporation of Bergen County (HDC); managed by Housing Authority of Bergen County (HABC)
sites.quote: Silver Maple Gardens I – 348 Leonia Avenue (Block 34, Lot 4.01): This development contains 10 affordable one bedroom units... Silver Maple Gardens II – 354 Leonia Avenue (Block 34, Lot 2.01): This development contains 10 affordable one bedroom units... the 20 units provided 20 credits that can be applied to the Fourth Round obligation.
sites.notes: Silver Maple Gardens I constructed 1993; Silver Maple Gardens II constructed 1996. Both 2-story garden apartment complexes restricted to Senior Citizens 62+. Standard 30-year affordability controls recently expired or expiring soon; HDC extending controls as part of its mission. Generates 20 credits (extension of controls) toward Fourth Round obligation with no bonus credits applicable (controls extension bonus not applicable to age-restricted). Age-restricted cap: max 30% of Round 4 obligation may be age-restricted = max 25.5 units; 20 units is within cap.

sites.site_name: West Fort Lee Road Redevelopment Area (The Atwater) — Prior Round/Third Round credit
sites.address: 172, 229 and 250 West Fort Lee Road, Bogota, NJ
sites.mechanism: redevelopment area (prior round/Third Round compliance only)
sites.quote: West Fort Lee Road Redevelopment Plan – 172, 229 and 250 West Fort Lee Road (Block 3, Lots 3, 4, 7, 8 & 9; Block 72, Lots 1, 2, 3 & 4): There are two adjoining redevelopment areas on West Fort Lee Road. A redevelopment plan has been prepared for this 13.125-acre area, with a maximum permitted density of 32 units per acre and a setaside of 10 percent of new dwelling units as low- and moderate-income units. The site plan and redeveloper's agreement for a 421-unit development, including 42 affordable units, was approved by the Bogota Planning Board in late 2016.
sites.notes: This site (The Atwater) was a Third Round compliance site providing 42 affordable units + 22 bonus credits = 64 credits toward Third Round. It is fully built and occupied. It is NOT a Fourth Round site — it is credited toward satisfying the Third Round obligation. The candidate snapshot listed it as the main site but this is incorrect for Fourth Round purposes. The 10% set-aside was due to site-specific contamination/remediation costs. 31 of 42 affordable units reserved for low/moderate-income military veterans.

sites.site_name: River Road Redevelopment Area — Unmet Need/Future
sites.current_zoning: Redevelopment area designation; 20% affordable housing overlay per Chapter XXIIB
sites.adoption_status: area designated but no redevelopment plan yet prepared; site not yet redeveloped
sites.quote: River Road Redevelopment Area – 300, 310 and 316 River Road (Block 64.01, Lots 6.01, 6.02 and 7.01): This 0.372-acre property is subject to a 20 percent affordable housing overlay per Chapter XXIIB of the Borough's General Ordinances. The site was also determined to be an area in need of redevelopment. A redevelopment plan has not yet been prepared for this area. This site has not been redeveloped to date.
sites.notes: Small 0.372-acre site with 20% set-aside overlay. At minimum density of 12 du/ac, could yield ~1 affordable unit. Listed in HEFSP as an 'other project' under existing inclusionary zoning. Contributes to Fourth Round unmet need compliance through mandatory set-aside ordinance if developed. No redevelopment plan has been prepared.
